namespace: sch-local
defaultProfile: full

releases:
  addons:
    type: addonsManifest
    manifest: cluster_addons/environments/local/cluster_addons.yaml

  infra:
    type: helm
    releaseName: sch-platform-infra
    chart: platform_infra
    valuesKeys:
      - kafka-broker
      - etcd
      - mqtt-broker
      - cnpg-cluster
      - prometheus
      - grafana
      - loki
      - promtail
      - identity-provider
      - nifi-cluster
    timeoutEnv: STACK_TIMEOUT_INFRA
    timeout: 20m
    waitForJobs: true
    values:
      - path: environments/local/shared.values.yaml
      - path: environments/local/images.values.yaml
        optional: true
      - path: environments/local/infrastructure.values.yaml
    postInstallWaits:
      - resource: cluster.postgresql.cnpg.io
        name: sch-cnpg
        condition: Ready
        timeout: 600s
        optional: true
      - resource: database.postgresql.cnpg.io
        name: sch-cnpg-harbor-db
        jsonpath: "{.status.applied}=true"
        timeout: 300s
        optional: true
      - resource: database.postgresql.cnpg.io
        name: sch-cnpg-nifi-registry-db
        jsonpath: "{.status.applied}=true"
        timeout: 300s
        optional: true

  nifi-registry:
    type: helm
    releaseName: sch-nifi-registry
    chart: platform_infra
    valuesKeys:
      - nifi-registry
    timeoutEnv: STACK_TIMEOUT_NIFI_REGISTRY
    timeout: 10m
    wait: true
    values:
      - path: environments/local/shared.values.yaml
      - path: environments/local/images.values.yaml
        optional: true
      - path: environments/local/infrastructure.values.yaml

  platform-registry:
    type: helm
    releaseName: harbor
    chart: platform_support/harbor
    valuesKeys:
      - harbor
      - ingress
      - robotAccount
    namespace: harbor
    timeout: 20m
    values:
      - path: cluster_addons/environments/local/harbor.yaml
    postInstallWaits:
      - resource: deployment
        namespace: harbor
        name: harbor-core
        condition: Available
=== images script ===
#!/bin/sh

set -eu

REGISTRY_HOST="${REGISTRY_HOST:-localhost:5001}"
IMAGE_NAMESPACE="${IMAGE_NAMESPACE:-sch}"
TAG="${TAG:-local}"
BUILDX_BUILDER_NAME="${BUILDX_BUILDER_NAME:-sch-builder}"

SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
REPO_ROOT=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../../../.." && pwd)
ROOT_ENV_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/.env"
PACKAGES_ENV_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/packages/.env"

trim_whitespace() {
  printf '%s' "$1" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//'
}

extract_env_value() {
  key="$1"
  env_file="$2"

  [ -f "$env_file" ] || return 1

  value=$(
    awk -v key="$key" '
      /^[[:space:]]*#/ || /^[[:space:]]*$/ { next }
      {
        line = $0
        sub(/^[[:space:]]*export[[:space:]]+/, "", line)
        if (index(line, key "=") != 1) {
          next
        }
        print substr(line, length(key) + 2)
        exit
      }
    ' "$env_file"
  )

  [ -n "$value" ] || return 1

  value=$(printf '%s' "$value" | sed 's/[[:space:]]#.*$//')
  value=$(trim_whitespace "$value")

  case "$value" in
    \"*\") value=${value#\"}; value=${value%\"} ;;
    \'*\') value=${value#\'}; value=${value%\'} ;;
  esac

  printf '%s' "$value"
}

lookup_env_file_value() {
  key="$1"

  for env_file in "$ROOT_ENV_FILE" "$PACKAGES_ENV_FILE"; do
    value=$(extract_env_value "$key" "$env_file" 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ -n "$value" ]; then
      printf '%s' "$value"
      return 0

observation.command: cd /workspace/deployment/runtimes/kubernetes && cat environments/local/stack.yaml 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo "=== images script ==="; sed -n 1,60p images/build_and_push_local.sh
